description: Returns links to free public services in Norway from the open index: state agencies by topic, and the website of any of the 357 municipalities. Public services are never ranked against businesses.

municipality.description: Name of a Norwegian municipality, e.g. Bodø, if the consumer needs local services

topic.description: What the consumer needs help with. Use municipality together with the municipality field.
